name: Delivery to Mathias
summary: Keryn Sylvius sends a sealed parcel from Goldshire to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind. The delivery offers a promising rogue a first look at SI:7's inner workings.

sections.title: A Courier's Test
sections.body: From the Lion's Pride Inn, a parcel must reach the Stormwind Barracks. For a young rogue, the journey is a test for Stormwind Intelligence. Keryn Sylvius entrusts the package to novice cutpurses, giving them their first meeting with Master Mathias Shaw. They must cross the capital quietly, keep a low profile, and follow discreet orders without questions.

sections.title: Gateway to SI:7
sections.body: The handoff brings an operative to SI:7 headquarters in Old Town. Mathias Shaw uses these deliveries to tell pretenders from true talents. Those who present the parcel without faltering receive field assignments. First come covert reconnaissance and infiltration against Defias smuggling networks in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: What is inside the Delivery to Mathias?
faq.answer: The parcel stays sealed to its courier. It may contain intelligence reports, trainee assessments, or confidential material about local threats such as the Defias Brotherhood in Elwynn.
Keryn Sylvius hands over the delivery. She is a rogue operative and trainer upstairs at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.

faq.q: Where does Mathias Shaw keep his headquarters?
faq.answer: Mathias Shaw keeps his headquarters on the second floor of the SI:7 building. It lies in the southeastern corner of Old Town within the Stormwind Barracks compound.

faq.q: What happens after presenting the parcel to Shaw?
faq.answer: After Shaw confirms your capability, he initiates you into field espionage and sends you to infiltrate Jerod's Landing. There, you steal a shipping schedule from a Defias dockmaster.

angles.text: As a rogue, you carry a package that marks the passage from petty back-alley brawling to royal intelligence under Mathias Shaw.
As an Alliance operative, you carry covert dispatches between regional scouts and the capital. Your work helps Stormwind's secretive espionage apparatus counter internal subversion.
